what_was_found_on_master: One-time-code and identity-provider sign-ins returned the legacy session reply to the portal and landed on /success?s=&t=0; they never reached package selection.
Every one-time code had failed since migration 0049 dropped auth_otps.template_id while internal/otp kept writing it (issue failed). Found by the live run; no test covered a post-0049 schema.
Social identity was keyed on the email string; the provider subject was discarded; no identity linking existed.
PRIOR_PURCHASE was keyed on the package revision, so a republish reset every free allowance; max_purchases_per_stay, renewable and plan_overrides were stored and never enforced.

Notification senders loaded once at scd boot; a failed send still answered that the code was sent; provider secrets were plaintext columns; no identity-provider host was reachable before sign-in; the walled garden was reset by every netd converge until scd's next minute.
delivered: One Client across verified factors: the provider subject is the identity, a trusted issuer's verified email links (google, apple, microsoft; never facebook), conflicts are recorded and never merged, pre-0107 rows resolve.

Client Groups (EMAIL_DOMAIN, IDP_TENANT, IDP_HOSTED_DOMAIN) decided by scd at sign-in from verified factors and pinned on the auth context with evidence; CLIENT_GROUP package audience rule; lowest priority wins.
Free allowance keyed on the package with within_hours and also_by_device; the list reports free_allowance_used so the package page explains the upgrade instead of showing an error.
A remembered device: a device-bound HMAC credential issued after a verified factor, usable only from that device, revoked elsewhere; Remember devices 0-365 days.
Portal journey: Welcome back, primary method, quick sign-in row, Or sign in with; seven strings in six languages.
Delivery: SMTP sender, secrets sealed by scd under notify_dek.key, test message, delivery health, reload on every write, 502 DELIVERY_FAILED to the client.
Identity-provider consent hosts enter the walled garden while a provider is offered; netd carries walled_garden_ip across a converge.
Admin Console: Client access section (Sign-in methods with the journey card, Client groups, Identity providers, Delivery, Portal settings, Allowed sites); package editor Audience and Free access.
